title: Modern Medicine Raised India’s Lifespan to 70+
description:
The average life expectancy of modern Indians is now around 70 years, thanks to the advances of modern medicine, vaccines, sanitation, and scientific healthcare. But what about the past? Before antibiotics, CT scans, and surgery, when Ayurveda claimed to be the “knowledge of life,” were people really living longer?

In this video, Pale Blue Thoughts takes a critical look at Ayurveda and contrasts it with evidence-based medicine. We explore the reality of ancient life expectancy, why infant mortality was high, how plagues and infections shaped history, and why only modern science—not pseudoscience—has given us the ability to live healthier, longer lives.

If you’ve searched for Ayurveda life expectancy, did Ayurveda work, Indian history life span, Ayurveda vs modern medicine, why life expectancy is rising, pseudoscience debunked, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations about science and skepticism.
